source_purity: Tier B source-dominant clinical targets, not clean isolated references
dataset_group: circor or sprsound, invariant across releases; linked IDs and duplicate components cannot cross partitions
age_mapping: preserve CirCor bins; SPR age in years<=1 Infant, 1<age<12 Child, 12<=age<=18 Adolescent; age unknown/unsupported stays null
pairing: uniform shared known age domain; within each source uniformly dataset then released sound-label family then subject then recording; uniform valid crop starts; no age as inference input
mixture: unchanged crop-RMS lung/heart uniform[-10,+10] dB and shared scale; both tensors divided by mixture peak
augmentation: independent valid crops and existing relative source gain only

external_validation.purpose: finite/generalization sanity on held-out external subjects, never checkpoint selection

hls_treatment_updates: control-selected earliest stable budget from frozen HLS-only plan; same budget for every treatment fold
hls_finetuning_optimizer: fresh AdamW state at0.001, same settings as control; no pretraining optimizer carryover
hls_treatment_selection: exact endpoint at control-selected budget; no treatment-specific checkpoint selection

adoption_gate.absolute_utility_gate: heart and lung macro SI-SDRi each >=1dB; every8 family-pair/source mean >=0dB; zero numerical failures
adoption_gate.interpretation: predeclared engineering gate, not statistical significance;0.5 exceeds twice prior observed0.226dB seed-Q gap

if_pilot_fails: stop external branch; apply original HLS-only control budget gate/refit if it passes; otherwise retain originalT8

if_pilot_passes.full_pool: all qualified public CirCor1.0.3 and canonical SPRSoundBioCAS2022-2025; exclude missing IDs, duplicates, poor quality, invalid/short data; preserve subject holdout rule
if_pilot_passes.full_adoption_gate: same gate against same control; failure ends branch, no pilot-only rescue
if_pilot_passes.final_refit: full external endpoint initialization, all45H41L HLSnon-test, exact same fixed finetuning budget, fresh optimizer and seed20260928; endpoint only; no validation scoring

stop_after: versioned replacementT8 or preserved originalT8; NEVER T9
